title: Run etcd clusters inside containers — etcd v3.7
version: etcd v3.7.0 official container guide; accessed 2026-11-26.
locator: Static bootstrap instructions for running an etcd cluster in containers, including a three-node cluster with initial-cluster peer URLs, member names, data directories and cluster token.
notes: Used to define a disposable local three-member Docker Compose topology. Container configuration is not a production deployment profile; this project has not yet executed the cluster.
